{{Libra}}
Libra 23 is the 303rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 23rd day of Libra, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 44, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 11宮23日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 303|Chapter 303]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152322}}.

[[Category:Days with weekday Tuesday]]
